name: VIP
source:
You've won a one-way trip to a new chapter in your life!

Journey towards the nicknamed [i]'gay capital'[/i] in pursuit of starting up your own strip club! Scout for new talent, interview and hire potential employees and manage your business! 

On top of that however; you've started a new life, in a new city. You've somehow got to create the room for a social life too! Meet new people, develop a relationship or indulge in many steamy encounters~

[From [url=https://munchbucketgames.itch.io/vip]Itch.io[/url]]

恭喜你赢得一张单程票，即将前往人生的新篇章！

前往那座绰号为[i]“同志之都”[/i]的城市，追求你的梦想，开一家自己的脱衣舞俱乐部！发掘新人，面试并聘用合适的员工，经营好你的生意！

不过，别忘了你也刚刚来到一座陌生的城市，开始新的生活。你总得想办法给社交留些空间！结识新朋友，发展一段感情，或是沉醉于一场又一场火辣的邂逅～
